info.name: Customer eCommerce API Collection
info.description: Comprehensive customer-facing storefront REST APIs for Laravel eCommerce project. Covers Authentication, Products, Categories, Collections, Search, Wishlist, Cart, Addresses, Checkout, and Orders.
